name: Ogre Fighter (Ogre Fighter 5)
body:
Ogre Fighter
CR 8

XP 4,800
Male Ogre Fighter 5
CE large humanoid (giant)
Init +0; Senses Darkvision 60 ft, Low-Light Vision, Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 9, flat 19 (+5 armor, +5 natural, -1 size)
hp 95 (4d8+5d10+5 favored class+45 Con)
Fort +15, Ref +2, Will +3; +1 vs. Fear Defensive Abilities Bravery 1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee +1 ogre hook +17/12 (2d8+14/19-20/x3)
Ranged Mwk composite Longbow +8/3 (2d6+7)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 11, Con 20, Int 6, Wis 12, Cha 4
Base Atk +8; CMB +16 (+18 on Bull Rush); CMD 26 (29 vs. Sunder and Disarm, 28 vs. Bull Rush)
Feats Cleave, Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (Ogre Hook), Power Attack, Weapon Focus (Ogre Hook), Weapon Specialization (Ogre Hook), Vital Strike
Skills Climb +13, Perception +5
Languages Common, Giant
SQ Armor Training 1; Weapon Training 1 (Heavy Blades)
Gear Ogre Hook +1, Hide Armor +1, Masterwork Composite Long Bow (+7 Str) and 20 arrows
